_doc: Built-in interiors (22 Nov 2026 pilot): what fills a kit building's hand-placed slot markers, per shop kind. A slot marker (Marker3D in <model>_interior.scn, meta slot_type, variant, lift) takes sets[kind][slot_type][variant]. There is NO fallback: a kind without a set, a slot type the set does not name, a variant out of range or a prop file that does not exist fails the validator and the bake (so a room can never be filled with stray plants). 'required' = slot types every model offering this kind must have. Props are kit indoor props (assets/coronado_kit/props/indoor, file base without prop_ and _clean_near).

office._doc: provisional (22 Nov): the bank hall as an office front room - Shore Bank (c_sw__com_bank__0) is assigned kind office on com_bank; a reception counter where the tellers sit, plants where the queue stands

_facing: One axis for props and slots: a kit indoor prop's front (screen + keyboard, drawer fronts, seat front, sign / picture face) is its local +Z; a slot marker's +Z (yaw) points that front TOWARD THE PERSON WHO USES OR READS IT. BuiltinLib.facing_problems checks it per kind: a desk's user chair (a slot whose prop is in the set's desk_users, default office_chair) within 1.1 m in front, facing back; a till's staff behind it; staff / seats facing the desk, till or counter they serve; wall things facing into the room. tools/city/rooms/builtin/prop_facing_sheet.gd renders every prop of a set from +Z.
